title: Air Scrubber Count for Tear-Out Dust in Water Damage Mitigation Drying
content:
Within Water Damage Mitigation drying, tear-out raises dust in the drying chamber, and the number of air scrubbers the drying estimate prices rises with it.

## Standard
On a Category 3 job carrying flood cut lines the air scrubbers are two more than the tier's required air scrubber count, on a Category 2 job carrying flood cut lines they are one more than that count, and on any other job no tear-out dust change applies. The tier's required air scrubber count is one on a tier that requires an air scrubber and none on a tier that does not.

## Resulting air scrubbers by tier, for a job carrying flood cut lines
| Tier | Air scrubber required on the tier | Air scrubbers |
|---|---|---|
| Clean Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | no | no tear-out dust change (Category 1) |
| Clean Water Mitigation - Large Loss | no | no tear-out dust change (Category 1) |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | no | 1 |
| Gray Water Mitigation - Large Loss | yes | 2 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Standard Loss | yes | 3 |
| Black Water Mitigation - Large Loss | yes | 3 |

A job with no flood cut line carries no tear-out dust change, whatever its category.
